backend/main.mo: Motoko canister providing access‑controlled user profiles and per‑user chat histories with basic system‑generated responses.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, and associated requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short descriptions of various frontend source files and their roles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining light/dark OKLCH color palettes and global styling variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with an empty title and root div that loads the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: React root component that sets site metadata and displays the site name centered on the page.
frontend/src/components/chat/MessageComp: Text input and send control supporting Enter‑to‑send, Shift+Enter newlines, and auto‑resizing.
frontend/src/components/chat/MessageThre: Scrollable message list rendering user and system messages with avatars, styling, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/chat/TypingIndic: Animated typing indicator showing the companion avatar and bouncing dots.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button handling Internet Identity authentication and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Initial setup form prompting the user to enter and submit their display name.
frontend/src/components/settings/Setting: UI dialog for editing companion settings such as name, relationship vibe, and conversation style.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries on identity change.
Manages companion settings with localStorage persistence and provides an update function.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, storage, and auth-client lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for user profile, conversation retrieval, sending messages with generated replies, and clearing conversation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and animations.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/generateRep: Builds a companion reply using intent detection, templates, seeded randomness, name substitution, and safety filtering.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/intents.ts: Detects user message intent via regex patterns mapped to predefined intent categories.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/persona.ts: Defines persona boundaries and style and filters responses to enforce safe, respectful behavior.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/responseLib: Defines a nested response library mapping intents and relationship vibes to short, balanced, and long response templates.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/seededRando: Implements a simple seeded random generator and a helper to select a deterministic variant from an array.
frontend/src/lib/siteMetadata.ts: Provides a function to set document title and related meta tags for site and Open Graph metadata.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and an Internet Identity provider, rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme extensions, colors, typography, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project state, scope, known issues, and feature definitions related to transitioning the app to a minimal personal landing page.
